description: Phase 1: Foundation & Environment — Scaffold Next.js app, extract megatrend docs, wire Vertex AI ADC credentials, initialize Prisma + SQLite with WAL mode. Nothing else can be built until this phase is done.

userStories.title: Set up Prisma with SQLite, WAL mode, and global singleton
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Prisma configured with SQLite so the app can persist projects and chat history.
acceptanceCriteria: Install `prisma` and `@prisma/client`
Run `npx prisma init --datasource-provider sqlite`

Create `src/lib/prisma.ts` with the global singleton pattern: `const globalForPrisma = globalThis as unknown as { prisma: PrismaClient }; export const prisma = globalForPrisma.prisma ?? new PrismaClient(); if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') globalForPrisma.prisma = prisma;`
Create `src/instrumentation.ts` that runs `PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL` via `prisma.$executeRawUnsafe('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')` on server startup
Add a stub model to `prisma/schema.prisma` and run `npx prisma migrate dev --name init` successfully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Prisma 7 + better-sqlite3 driver adapter. PrismaClient imported from @/generated/prisma/client. Singleton in src/lib/prisma.ts. WAL mode set via src/instrumentation.ts on nodejs runtime. Migration: 20260321150637_init. db file at ./dev.db (gitignored).

userStories.title: Extract megatrend documents to plain text files
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the megatrend .docx and .pdf files converted to plain text so they can be injected as Vertex AI context.
acceptanceCriteria: Install `mammoth`, `pdf-parse`, and `@types/pdf-parse`
Create `scripts/extract-docs.ts` that reads all files from `Trend Mapper/MEGATRENDS Docs for TrendMapper/`
Extracts each .docx using `mammoth.extractRawText()` and the .pdf using `pdf-parse`
Writes output to `src/context/megatrend-1.txt`, `megatrend-2.txt`, `megatrend-3.txt`, `megatrend-4.txt`
Run the script: `npx ts-node --skip-project scripts/extract-docs.ts`
All 4 `.txt` files are non-empty and contain readable text (not binary garbage)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Source files: 'Deep Research Report ChaqtGPT.docx', 'Global_Megatrends_Impact_Impulse_Matrix_2025-2050 (Claude).docx', 'Spotting_Big_Trends_Megatrends_Handout.pdf', 'The Great Fragmentation GEMINI Deep Research.docx' — all in 'Trend Mapper/MEGATRENDS Docs for TrendMapper/'

userStories.title: Create server-side context loader for system prompt and megatrend docs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a context loader that assembles the full system prompt + knowledge base as a string ready for Vertex AI injection.
acceptanceCriteria: Copy `Trend Mapper/FUND_II_Trend_Mapper_System_Prompt.txt` to `src/context/system-prompt.txt`
Create `src/lib/context.ts` that exports `getSystemContext(): string`
Function reads `system-prompt.txt` then all 4 megatrend `.txt` files using `fs.readFileSync`

Combines them with `

---KNOWLEDGE BASE DOCUMENT---

` as separator between docs
Add `import 'server-only'` at top to prevent client-side imports (install `server-only` package)
Verify: `npx ts-node --skip-project -e "const {getSystemContext} = require('./src/lib/context'); console.log('Context length:', getSystemContext().length)"` outputs a number > 10000
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Verify Vertex AI ADC authentication with a smoke test API route
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to confirm Vertex AI credentials work before building the chat pipeline on top of them.
acceptanceCriteria: Install `@google-cloud/vertexai`
Add `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` and `GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION` (e.g. `us-central1`) to `.env.local`
Create `src/app/api/smoke-test/route.ts` with `export const runtime = 'nodejs'`
Route sends a single non-streaming message to Vertex AI: 'Hello, respond with just the word READY'
Returns `{ ok: true, response: '...' }` as JSON
Test: GET http://localhost:3000/api/smoke-test returns `{ ok: true }` with a valid response string
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MUST have `export const runtime = 'nodejs'` — edge runtime breaks gcloud ADC auth. If ADC fails, set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS in .env.local pointing to ~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json
